name: engineering-agent-skills
description: Independent portable project bootstrap and cross-repository governance Agent Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Portable project initialization and cross-repository governance
interface.longDescription: Two independent Agent Skills: project-bootstrap creates a portable AGENTS.md and explicit rule index; cross-repo-governance coordinates approved shared contracts, verifies exact repository revisions and creates reproducible release manifests. Design decisions belong to Grill; implementation and local tests belong to the active agent.
defaultPrompt: Use project-bootstrap to initialize this repository's AGENTS.md and .agents/rules.
Use cross-repo-governance to coordinate this approved shared interface change.
Use cross-repo-governance to verify this multi-repository revision set.
Use cross-repo-governance to produce a manifest for the verified release.
